result_preview.title: Procurement Matching Agent
result_preview.shortDescription: Autonomously matches purchase requisitions to optimal vendors based on cost, quality, and delivery performance.
result_preview.description: This agent analyzes open purchase requisitions against vendor master data, historical performance metrics, and material specifications to automatically recommend and create purchase orders. It evaluates vendor pricing, lead times, quality ratings, and contract terms to optimize procurement decisions, reducing manual effort and ensuring compliance with preferred vendor agreements.

result_preview.title: Dangerous Goods Supply Chain Safety Agent
result_preview.shortDescription: Tracks hazardous material declarations from vendors and triggers response protocols for safety events.
result_preview.description: Automates oversight of hazardous material certifications within the supplier ecosystem and ingests real-time safety event notifications. Executes regulatory verification processes, identifies non-compliance signals, and routes urgent safety alerts to procurement teams for corrective intervention and risk mitigation across the supply chain.

result_preview.title: Contract and Procurement Compliance Analytics
result_preview.shortDescription: Aggregates contract terms, purchase order execution, and vendor compliance metrics.
result_preview.description: Aggregates contract lifecycle data, purchase order fulfillment patterns, and vendor adherence to compliance standards to provide comprehensive procurement governance insights. Summarizes contract performance indicators, PO-to-contract alignment metrics, and vendor regulatory compliance status. Provides metrics on procurement risk exposure, contract utilization rates, and vendor compliance trends across sourcing initiatives.
